requirements.title: EN output uses engineering notation and ignores scale factor
requirements.definition: EN output uses engineering notation with exponent divisible by three and significand magnitude in [1,1000) except zero; scale factor has no output effect.

pending.EN-exponent-divisible-by-three: Internal WRITE(buf,'(SS,EN12.3E2)') 0.5 expects exponent '-03' and, with SS, exact buf=' 500.000E-03'.
pending.EN-significand-range: The same 0.5 plan expects yyy='500', satisfying 1<=yyy<1000 after scaling.
pending.EN-scale-factor-no-effect: After 13.8.6 scale-factor ownership, internal WRITE(buf,'(SS,1P,EN12.3E2)') 8.0 to character(len=12) expects exactly buf='   8.000E+00', the same as '(SS,0P,EN12.3E2)' because EN output ignores scale factor.

requirements.title: Table 13.2 enumerates EN exponent forms
requirements.definition: Table 13.2 gives row-by-row EN exponent forms for EN w.d, EN w.d E e, EN w.d E0, and EN0.d, with z digits, s minimum digits, and plus sign for zero exponent.

pending.table13_2_EN_w_d_abs_le_99: Unassertable as one exact string for this row: Table 13.2 permits either E±z1z2 or ±0z1z2 for EN w.d with w>0 and |exp|<=99. Use EN w.d E e for byte-exact output.
pending.table13_2_EN_w_d_abs_100_to_999: Unassertable as a portable byte-exact plan in this packet: the row requires an exponent magnitude at least 100 and the table form omits the E letter.
pending.table13_2_EN_Ee_positive: Row checked visually: EN w.d E e with e>0 uses E±z1...ze; WRITE(buf,'(SS,EN12.3E2)') 8.0 expects '   8.000E+00'.
pending.table13_2_EN_E0_or_EN0_d: Row checked visually: EN w.d E0 or EN0.d uses E±z1...zs with minimum exponent digits. Internal WRITE(buf,'(SS,EN0.3E0)') 8.0 to character(len=8) expects exactly buf='8.000E+0'.
pending.table13_2_zero_exponent_plus: Row footnote checked visually: exponent zero has plus sign; the 8.0 EN12.3E2 plan expects '+00'.

review_rationale: Independent fresh-context source review, three rounds: doc/source_audits/batch_137.json. The reviewer re-derived unit hashes and read Tables 13.1, 13.2 and 13.3 ROW BY ROW against the PDF, independently of the author's reconstruction - necessary because extraction interleaved the columns and every future E/EN/ES fixture derives from those rows. THREE blocking findings. The integrator found the first directly: two sample plans gave a NEGATIVE result for the POSITIVE input 0.5, but SS suppresses the optional plus so the sign position must be BLANK - corrected to ' 500.000E-03' and '   5.000E-01', hand-derived and corroborated with gfortran. C137SR-001: ELEVEN units mixing an obligation with a grant of latitude were dispositioned wholly as permission - the fourth occurrence of that class this session - and were re-dispositioned to requirements with the latitude confined to rationale and oracle text; the reviewer confirmed no latitude is now wrongly asserted as an obligation. C137SR-002: placeholder plans remained, saying things like 'future plan must include exact output'; 48 entries were changed, 21 upgraded to exact executable strings and 27 marked explicitly unassertable, and the reviewer independently derived the scale-factor cases -1P,E10.3E2 giving ' 0.010E+02' and 1P,E10.3E2 giving ' 1.000E+00'. R1323 carries no diagnostic facet because it defines a hex-digit-string form and prohibits nothing. Source accounting only: authored_facets unchanged at 1977.
